title: Go Tubing in Austin's Downtown Spring River
blurb:
This is a private tubing experience for groups of 10-15 people. We are the only company that offers tubing in Downtown Austin. What sets our trip apart from competitors is we are going on the spring river created by Barton Springs pool. This means that you won't waste 4 hours on a bus and you can make the most of your time in Austin.

Every minute of this tour you will be in the water, and when you get out, you'll be just a few minutes away from restaurants, bars, etc. 

Furthermore, you can choose to stay and linger in the area after the tour and continue the water fun unlike the competitors who will herd back onto a bus and make you sit through traffic for hours to get back to Austin. 

The float is slow. Highlights are watching the bridge jumpers and rope swingers and ending at Party Island.
